hero_subhead: Burst pipe or broken boiler in Wolverhampton? Shaun Clarke arrives within the hour, any day of the week.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Wolverhampton
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full central heating installation, we handle every plumbing job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and flooding demand fast action. We're on the road within the hour, 24/7, with all tools and spare parts ready to fix the problem on the spot.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Modern, efficient boilers cut your heating bills and come with manufacturer warranties. We handle the full install, paperwork, and give you a clear breakdown of costs upfront.

services.title: Central Heating Repairs
services.desc: Cold radiators, noisy pipes, or a boiler that won't fire? Shaun diagnoses most faults the same day and carries common parts on the van to get you warm again quickly.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Replacement
services.desc: Leaking, cold, or stuck radiators are no match for us. We repair, balance, or swap them out with minimal fuss and mess.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: New tap installations, under-sink pipework, and full bathroom refits. We work neatly and leave sites clean so you can use your space the same day.

services.title: Powerflush & System Cleaning
services.desc: Sludge and scale in your pipes slow heat flow and waste energy. A powerflush restores efficiency, extends your boiler's life, and often cuts heating bills by 15–20%.

about_pullquote: I started this because I'd seen too many emergency engineers overcharge scared families.
about_para_1: Shaun Clarke Plumbing & Heating has been serving Wolverhampton homes and businesses for over 15 years. Shaun built the business on the principle that emergency plumbing shouldn't mean emergency costs — honest diagnosis, fair pricing, and work that's done right the first time. Gas Safe registered and fully insured, we've completed over 2,500 jobs and earned the trust of thousands of local customers.
about_para_2: We're known for turning up when we say we will, fixing the problem, and explaining what we've done in plain English. Repeat customers and referrals make up the bulk of our work because we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned boiler upgrade, you get the same professional attention and transparent pricing.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Customers Say About Shaun Clarke Plumbing

reviews.text: Woke up to a burst pipe under the kitchen at half seven on a Sunday morning. Rang Shaun in a panic and he was here by eight. Had the leak capped, drying gear set up, and gave me a fair quote for repair all before nine. Brilliant bloke. Would absolutely use him again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our old combi boiler replaced last month. Shaun explained the whole process, gave us a fixed price with no surprises, and the install was done in a day. Been running perfectly since and the house feels so much warmer. Best decision we made.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Radiators stone cold in three rooms mid-winter. Shaun came the next day, bled them out, and balanced the whole system. Very professional, very clean work, and he explained why it happened. Would recommend to anyone in Wolverhampton.
reviews.author: James P.
